## Notes

Grizzly Games (Coatsink from 2022); Windows 2019-04-04; Switch, PS4, Xbox One 2021; Meta Quest 2023; buildings score points from proximity to compatible structures and lose points for incompatible ones; placements are permanent; point thresholds offer a choice of two building packs; filling the gauge unlocks a new island; no resources, traffic, or research; global leaderboard only.
